item.description: Anthropic says DoD has threatened to cancel its $200 million contract and label the company as “supply chain risk."

item.title: India-Israel defence partnership: Iron Dome tech transfer, Joint production of equipment — All that happened during PM Modi's 2-day visit
item.description: India and Israel agreed to jointly develop and manufacture defence equipment, moving beyond a traditional buyer-seller dynamic.

item.title: Silver price on Feb 27: White metal surges Rs 8,300/kg, nears Rs 2.7 lakh as geopolitical tensions lift safe-haven demand
item.description: On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), silver futures for March 2026 delivery climbed ₹8,340, or 3.2%, to settle at ₹2,68,009 per kilogram. The move places domestic silver prices within striking distance of the ₹2.7 lakh psychological threshold. In contrast, gold futures for April 2026 delivery rose ₹482, or 0.3%, to ₹1,60,191 per 10 grams.

item.title: Why is market down today: Top reasons behind Sensex, Nifty fall
item.description: Sensex lost 575 points to 81,673 against the previous close of 82,248. Nifty too declined 204 points to 25,292 a day after ending flat.

item.title: ‘Bottom is in’: Aussie hedge fund GCQ bets $143 million on beaten-down software stocks
item.description: GCQ Funds Management believes that the 'bottom' is in place for the sell-off seen in software stocks globally, taking decisive stance on the ongoing volatility in software and technology equities

item.title: Delhi excise policy case: Arvind Kejriwal, Manish Sisodia get relief; CBI to approach Delhi High Court
item.description: The court rebuked the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) and ruled that the prosecution failed to substantiate its allegations with credible evidence.

item.title: xAI founding member Toby Pohlen departs as Elon Musk’s AI startup faces wave of exits
item.description: The departure comes amid what appears to be a broader exodus from xAI. Two co-founders and at least six other researchers have left the company in recent weeks.

item.title: Big Relief For Flyers! Air tickets now cancellable within 48 hours without penalty
item.description: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has introduced new passenger-friendly rules allowing flyers to cancel or modify tickets without extra charges within 48 hours of booking. The benefit applies only if the domestic travel date is at least seven days away and for international flights, at least 14 days away.
